intro: The {year} field is set, the cars have completed testing, and the preseason picture is as clear as it will get before the first lights go out.
Testing is done and the {year} entry list is locked — what teams found across the winter shows up in the car, not in the press release.
The {year} grid has taken shape: shakedowns run, programmes complete, freight loaded for the first race.

The {year} cars are built, tested, and shipped — the field's shape is now readable for the first time.

{champion} carries the number 1 into {year}; {constructor}'s car is the one every rival spent the winter benchmarking.
{champion} secured the drivers' title last season; {constructor} secured the constructors'. Both carry the weight of that status into {year}.

{constructor} is the team to beat on last season's evidence, and {champion} is the driver who clinched the title before the finale: the reference point as {year} starts.

{names} — the combination of machinery and track record that a realistic title shot requires is there.

{names} — the ability and the circumstance to produce results above the car's baseline are both present.

{names} — capable of mattering on any given Sunday, in machinery that won't carry a title run but will carry points and occasionally a podium.
bestOfRest: Behind the championship contenders, the midfield has its own hierarchy — {teams} sit at the top of it.
{teams} head into {year} with the trajectory and resources to lead the fight among teams outside the title picture.

The argument that a long career erodes competitiveness does not apply to {names} — front-running pace is still the baseline.
{names}: experienced enough to know exactly what a car requires, still fast enough to be at the front when it gets it.

{names} — the kind of experience that reads a race correctly and the pace to act on it; both are still intact.
veteransTwilight: Points finishes will measure a good day for {names} at this stage — that is an honest benchmark, not a dismissive one.
{names} — accomplished careers now carrying more measured expectations than in years past.

{names} — capable of scoring on the right weekend, operating toward the back of the competitive order, with careers that have earned the honest assessment.
